# Prava Labs

> Prava Labs, LLC is an independent software studio building local-first, private-by-design apps and on-device AI tools. Products are grouped by device: iPhone, iPad, Mac and Apple Watch (TradeSocial, BoatNavi, Pravida, EchoBridge, Mavee, ScreenShare), and Mac and PC (Toolport, PrintRelay).

## Products

- [TradeSocial](https://pravalabs.app/tradesocial/) — live on the App Store: TradeSocial teaches investing by doing it, with nothing at risk. Start with $5,000 in virtual money and trade stocks, ETFs and crypto at real market prices, on your own for free. Form a group of up to eight friends, family or coworkers: everyone gets their own budget, the group grows it with milestone bonuses up to $15,000 per member, and you compare portfolios, talk trades in chat and climb the leaderboard together. 100% paper trading. iPhone and iPad.
  - [Support](https://pravalabs.app/tradesocial/support.html) · [Privacy Policy](https://pravalabs.app/tradesocial/privacy.html) · [Terms of Service](https://pravalabs.app/tradesocial/terms.html)
- [Prava Toolport](https://pravalabs.app/toolport/) — live on the Mac App Store: Prava Toolport sits between any AI agent and all your MCP servers, handing the agent only the few right tools per task — in any language. Plus built-in modules: savings receipts, policy gates, output condensing, web retrieval, semantic cache, and durable memory.
  - [Support](https://pravalabs.app/toolport/support.html) · [Download](https://pravalabs.app/toolport/download.html) · [Privacy Policy](https://pravalabs.app/toolport/privacy.html) · [Terms of Service](https://pravalabs.app/toolport/terms.html)
- [BoatNavi](https://pravalabs.app/boatnavi/) — in TestFlight: Navi and Boat, one chart. Navi: charted depth plus the tide, minus your draft and margin, coloured on the chart for the next 48 hours across San Francisco Bay and the Sacramento–San Joaquin Delta, South Bay to West Sacramento — offline. Boat: your instruments over Signal K, NMEA 0183 or Raymarine SeaTalk1, batteries, tanks, the autopilot, and an anchor watch that wakes you.
  - [Support](https://pravalabs.app/boatnavi/support.html) · [Privacy Policy](https://pravalabs.app/boatnavi/privacy.html)
- [Pravida](https://pravalabs.app/pravida/) — in TestFlight: Pravida is a private, invite-only, end-to-end encrypted messenger for the people you actually know. Create a chat, share a link or QR code, and talk — every message encrypted on your device with keys that never leave it, relayed through iCloud or sent directly between nearby devices over Wi‑Fi when there is no internet. No account, no phone number, no server of ours. Smart replies, summaries and translation run on the device. iPhone, iPad, Mac and Apple Watch.
  - [Support](https://pravalabs.app/pravida/support.html) · [Privacy Policy](https://pravalabs.app/pravida/privacy.html) · [Terms of Service](https://pravalabs.app/pravida/terms.html)
- [EchoBridge](https://pravalabs.app/echobridge/) — in TestFlight: A live conversation translator for iPhone and iPhone Duo that helps with both halves of a conversation. Hear what is said in your language, in your own Bluetooth headphones, as it is spoken; then three short replies appear in the other person's language, each with its meaning in yours. Tap one and your iPhone says it aloud, or hold to talk or type and it translates you. Speech recognition, translation and reply suggestions run on the iPhone with Apple's frameworks; audio never recorded, transcripts kept only if you choose.
  - [Support](https://pravalabs.app/echobridge/support.html) · [Privacy Policy](https://pravalabs.app/echobridge/privacy.html) · [Terms of Service](https://pravalabs.app/echobridge/terms.html)
- [Mavee](https://pravalabs.app/mavee/) — in TestFlight: Your day, simplified. Mavee brings your calendar, mail, contacts, reminders, tasks, files and health together on the device and shows what needs you today: calendars that collide, a bill due, a flight with no calendar entry, a document to re-read before a meeting, a birthday this week, each with a one-tap action, plus three always-on cards (the mail and files behind your next meeting, your first open hour with the to-do that fits it, the people you talked to most this week) and tappable questions. A notification fifteen minutes before any meeting that has material behind it. My Day is your calendar with the mail and files behind each meeting; Search finds anything across your data or answers a question from it, using Apple's on-device model. Apple, Microsoft 365, Google and Spotify sources; no server, no account of its own. iPhone, iPhone Duo (one column closed, two open), iPad and Mac.
  - [Support](https://pravalabs.app/mavee/support.html) · [Privacy Policy](https://pravalabs.app/mavee/privacy.html) · [Terms of Service](https://pravalabs.app/mavee/terms.html)
- [Prava PrintRelay](https://pravalabs.app/printrelay/) — in TestFlight: A Mac menu bar app that shares the printers set up on your Mac as AirPrint printers, so iPhone, iPhone Duo and iPad print to USB, older network and driver-based printers from the normal Print sheet, with nothing to install on the phone. Up to eight PDF printers save what you print into their own folders on the Mac, then open each file in any app that opens PDF or hand it to a Shortcut. Android, Chromebook and Windows print too through IPP Everywhere; optional password per printer over TLS. Sandboxed; print jobs stay on your network. 14-day free trial, then $19.99 a year. macOS 26 and later.
  - [Support](https://pravalabs.app/printrelay/support.html) · [Privacy Policy](https://pravalabs.app/printrelay/privacy.html) · [Terms of Use](https://pravalabs.app/printrelay/terms.html)
- [ScreenShare](https://pravalabs.app/screenshare/) — in TestFlight: An iPad app that shows and controls your Mac through the Screen Sharing built into macOS, with nothing to install on the Mac. Sign in with your Mac user name and password, use a Magic Keyboard, trackpad, mouse or touch, open several Macs at once in separate windows, and encrypt the whole session through an optional SSH tunnel. iPad only, iPadOS 18 or later; 14-day free trial, then 14.99 USD a year or 39.99 USD once.
  - [Support](https://pravalabs.app/screenshare/support.html) · [Privacy Policy](https://pravalabs.app/screenshare/privacy.html) · [Terms of Use](https://pravalabs.app/screenshare/terms.html)
